points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable e998060 clean CMake build succeeds with warnings in network-disabled cfd-bench (2 CPUs, 3 GiB); no CFD rerun.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:106–121 reads current restart state, step and time but only passes the state into solver; transient history and resume time are not restored.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Source separates mesh, partition, finite-volume solver, gas model, I/O and utilities; numerical result evidence is unavailable.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Inspected finite-volume, gas, mesh, partition and halo code; no affirmative copied-core or wrapper evidence, without exhaustive external-authorship search.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Input.cpp reads case/mesh settings, mesh code imports configured CGNS, and METIS partitions adjacency; no two-filename-only branch found.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:93–104 broadcasts preprocessing mesh and drops it on nonroot before solve; METIS, neighbor state exchange and global reductions exist.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Output.cpp:453 writes completed=true independent of status; no original case metadata survives to establish a submitted false success. Restart does not restore history/time. Historical contestant commit cf36ac0e77b12262705387d74bc06566a192258b was subsequently found to contain eight packages and original figures; the prior absence statement described the live workspace and is superseded for deliverable evidence. Individual scores remain under review.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Clean build passes; no delivered case packages or figures exist in current workspace to independently validate claimed results or rank checks.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modular source and extensive comments exist, with compiler/runtime-search-path warnings and environment-dependent tuning.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
